    • registerInputSlots

      void registerInputSlots(@NotNull @NotNull Collection<Integer> positions)
      Registers slot positions that accept items being placed into them. The click handler uses this registry to distinguish PLACE from SWAP when a slot already contains a placeholder/rendered item — required for any input-style slot whose placeholder would otherwise be read as "slot is occupied" by the inventory.

      Slots typically also declare SlotBehavior.input() on their GuiItem, but this registry covers the legacy/edge-case path where items have no behavior set.

      Parameters:
      positions - the slot positions that accept placing items

    • unregisterInputSlots

      void unregisterInputSlots(@NotNull @NotNull Collection<Integer> positions)
      Removes the given positions from the input slot registry. Useful when a GUI is rebuilt/closed and the old positions should stop being treated as inputs.
      Parameters:
      positions - the slot positions to deregister
